# List of international presidential trips made by Michael Randrianirina

This is a list of international presidential trips made by Michael Randrianirina, President of Madagascar and President of the Council of the Presidency for the Re-Foundation of the Republic of Madagascar since 17 October 2025. Randrianirina has made four international trips since his presidency began on 17 October 2025.
Summary
The number of visits per country where he has traveled are:
* One: France, Russia, South Africa, and the United Arab Emirates
